tail:
**Batch 34 authoring is complete for handoff.** I clarified the full conditional kernel’s empty-product convention, completed the conditional-independence proof, made the finite-support example explicit on the ambient product space, and added the missing moment and integrability steps to the Gaussian nonreversibility example. The manifest, contracts, coverage, notes, and cross-batch evidence are consistent.

The A page and B page are [here](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/bayesian-computational-statistics/gibbs-sampling-and-scan-schemes.md) and [here](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/bayesian-computational-statistics/gibbs-sampling-and-scan-schemes-examples.md). Batch evidence is in the [manifest](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/bayesian-computational-statistics-62-batch-34.pages.json), [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/bayesian-computational-statistics-62-batch-34.proof-contracts.json), [coverage](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/bayesian-computational-statistics-62-batch-34.coverage.json), [notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/bayesian-computational-statistics-62-batch-34.notes.md), and [cross-batch dependencies](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/bayesian-computational-statistics-62-batch-34.cross-batch-dependencies.json).

**Scoped checks passed:** all 16 contracts, dependency levels 0–5, proof layout (4 items, 8 steps), precheck, rendercheck, depcheck, content policy, coverage checklist, and source fetch (4/4 sources verified). I read Owen’s relevant Gibbs sections and Roberts–Rosenthal’s scan sections in full ([Owen](https://artowen.su.domains/mc/Ch-MCMC.pdf), [Roberts–Rosenthal](https://probability.ca/jeff/ftpdir/probsurv.pdf)).

**Owner reconciliation remains:** all 16 existing batch-34 readiness records remain escalated; I did not overwrite them. The BCS-29/30 pages and relevant item bodies are present, but BCS-30 readiness is not recorded. A fresh readiness check is blocked by malformed JSON in the batch-33 proof contracts at line 31, column 40. The last autopilot status inspection also showed the run in `1-scaffold` with 2/62 covered and a separate malformed-title handoff blocker outside this pair.
